import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { currentNodes } from "./current_nodes";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to current_nodes (its only foreign key inside the primary key) and nothing else references it.
// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "k" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "v" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const currentNodeTags = defineTable("current_node_tags", {
    columns: {
        nodeId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        k: col.text().primaryKey().default(""),
        v: col.text().notNull().default("")
    },
    relations: {
        node: rel.belongsTo(() => currentNodes, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
